fee_issue.summary: Users misunderstand non-brokerage transaction fees and feel misled when deductions occur on unexecuted orders or erode small intraday profits.

llm2.observation: Across 3216 reviews, 228 cited high brokerage and unexpected charges. Specifically, 26 out of 127 users mentioning trade charges found them unexpected or unclear, a 20.5% rate driven by misunderstandings of non-brokerage fees.
actions: Show a complete pre-trade breakdown of estimated brokerage, DP, and statutory charges directly on the order confirmation screen.
Implement automated routing and dedicated escalation queues for customer care support tickets regarding account deletion and fund withdrawals.
Deploy crash monitoring and optimize charting libraries to resolve persistent application crashes and interface latency.
explainer_bullets: Brokerage is charged at ₹20 or 0.1% of the order value, whichever is lower, with a minimum of ₹5 per executed order.
Selling shares from the demat account also attracts a DP charge: ₹16.50 charged by Groww plus ₹3.50 charged by the depository.
The ₹16.50 Groww fee is not charged when the debit value is under ₹100, and intraday orders carry no DP charge.
An 18% GST applies on brokerage and DP charges.
Regulatory and statutory charges such as STT, stamp duty and SEBI turnover fees are listed separately on the pricing page.
